description: Create a new ad. Requires name, adset_id, and creative (JSON object_story_spec). Defaults to PAUSED status.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to create the ad in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

creative.description: JSON string of creative spec (object_story_spec with page_id, link_data/photo_data/video_data). Note: as of v26.0, a creative with applink_treatment=web_only can no longer be attached to an ad in a campaign using Website and App conversion locations — use automatic destination selection or a compatible manual destination instead.

tracking_specs.description: JSON string of tracking specs array

name: create_ad
